research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Iron Ox is researching wireless sensors for agricultural modules, methods for targeted output and plant distribution within automated agricultural facilities, systems for propagating seeds to seedlings with automated lighting and flooding, apparatuses for control and distribution of nutriated water, automation of plant transfer, and methods for monitoring plant growth and generating grow schedules. These areas reflect a focus on integrating technology to optimize renewable food production.

overview_description.description:
Iron Ox is pioneering a sustainable and precise way of growing fresh produce, using robotics and plant science, to reduce agriculture’s impact on global climate.

Iron Ox was established in 2015 and has greenhouses in Gilroy, CA and Lockhart, TX.
